name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

mainEntity.name: What should I look for when choosing a general contractor for my home renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a general contractor, prioritize those with proven experience in projects similar to yours and a strong portfolio. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure they meet state requirements and protect your property. Look for clear communication, transparent bidding, and a detailed contract outlining the scope of work, timeline, and payment schedule. Checking references and reading reviews can provide insight into their reliability and professionalism. A good contractor ensures quality and manages the project effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a general contractor with relevant experience, proper licensing and insurance, clear communication, transparent bids, and positive references.
